comment:
* This class scans a directory containing overlay APKs and extracts information from the overlay
 * manifests by parsing the overlay manifests.

variables.name: mParsedOverlayInfos
variables.comment:
* A map of overlay package name to the parsed manifest information of the latest version of
     * the overlay.

variables.name: mExcludedOverlayPackages
variables.comment:
* A list of pair<packageName, apkFile> which is excluded from the system based on the
     * system property condition.
     *
     * @see #isExcludedOverlayPackage(String, OverlayConfigParser.OverlayPartition)

methods.name: public final ParsedOverlayInfo getParsedInfo(String packageName)
methods.comment: Retrieves information parsed from the overlay with the package name.

methods.name: final Collection<ParsedOverlayInfo> getAllParsedInfos()
methods.comment: Retrieves all of the scanned overlays.

methods.name: final boolean isExcludedOverlayPackage(@NonNull String packageName, @NonNull OverlayConfigParser.OverlayPartition overlayPartition)
methods.comment:
* Returns {@code true} if the given package name on the given overlay partition is an * excluded overlay package. *

* An excluded overlay package declares overlay attributes of required system property in its * manifest that do not match the corresponding values on the device.

methods.name: public void scanDir(File partitionOverlayDir)
methods.comment:
* Recursively searches the directory for overlay APKs. If an overlay is found with the same
     * package name as a previously scanned overlay, the info of the new overlay will replace the
     * info of the previously scanned overlay.

methods.name: public ParsedOverlayInfo parseOverlayManifest(File overlayApk, List<Pair<String, File>> outExcludedOverlayPackages)
methods.comment:
* Extracts information about the overlay from its manifest. Adds the package name and apk file
     * into the {@code outExcludedOverlayPackages} if the apk is excluded from the system based
     * on the system property condition.

methodNames: final boolean isExcludedOverlayPackage(@NonNull String packageName, @NonNull OverlayConfigParser.OverlayPartition overlayPartition)
public ParsedOverlayInfo parseOverlayManifest(File overlayApk, List<Pair<String, File>> outExcludedOverlayPackages)
